body:
Create a production DRAFT animation spritesheet for the attached chibi pixel Slayer, with ABSOLUTELY NO SWORD OR WEAPON IN ANY HAND. Keep exact approved costume: cream upright hair, blue forehead guard, navy side locks/feather shoulder trim, blue open vest, bare torso, blue/ivory trousers, green ankle accents, magenta anatomical LEFT arm with cuff. Pixel art with coarse uniform square clusters. Output a perfectly regular 4 COLUMN by 6 ROW grid, 24 equal square cells, on a genuine transparent background. Square cells, total canvas aspect ratio 2:3 (width:height), no gutters, no text, no grid lines. Each character roughly 70% of cell height with feet at 85% cell height, centered at 50% cell width. Every frame must remain inside its own cell with generous margins. Consistent size and face in all 24 cells. No equipment, no shadows, no effects.
Rows in exact order:
ROW 1: FOUR left-facing IDLE breathing frames, nearly identical stable feet, slight shoulder/chest breathing.
ROW 2: FOUR left-facing WALK cycle frames: left foot forward, passing pose, right foot forward, passing pose; real leg and arm position changes, clothing follows motion, head stays consistent.
ROW 3: FOUR left-facing empty-handed RIGHT-ARM SWORD SWING body poses, no sword drawn: anticipation hand above head, impact hand extended left at waist height, follow-through hand low left, recovery hand beside waist. Cursed LEFT arm balances the movement. Palm/gripping fingers visible to attach external sword later. Full-body animation not four identical poses.
ROW 4: FOUR right-facing IDLE frames matching row1 timing, with anatomical LEFT cursed arm on far side and normal RIGHT arm near side. Do NOT merely flip cursed anatomy.
ROW 5: FOUR right-facing WALK cycle frames matching row2 timing, anatomically correct normal right arm nearest viewer, cursed left arm farther away.
ROW 6: FOUR right-facing RIGHT-ARM SWORD SWING body poses matching row3: normal RIGHT hand near side performs sword swing, cursed LEFT arm balances on far side. No sword drawn.
This sheet is for slicing into 24 fixed cells, not a concept collage. All cells must be exactly regular, same character scale, same baseline, no clipping. NO WEAPONS IN ANY FRAME.
weapons: Generate a game WEAPON SPRITE SHEET with exactly TWO swords, each isolated on genuine fully transparent background. Canvas landscape 2:1, two equal square cells. Left cell: plain broad steel sword with gray straight blade angled tip, dark leather grip and simple silver crossguard. Right cell: same grip length and sword size, dark iron broad blade with a narrow cyan inset and pale cyan edge, black grip and silver crossguard. Each sword points straight UP, handle at bottom, full sword within own cell with 12% transparent padding. Crisp coarse PIXEL ART matching reference's stepped contours and simple shaded pixel clusters. No hands, characters, scenery, glow spilling into background, text, shadows or additional objects. Two independent equipment options for swapping, equal apparent length, exact vertical alignment.
